content.text: Work through one map-maintenance request end to end. The workspace already contains hospitals.csv; do not run shell commands or list directories. Import hospitals.csv from the workspace with data_import; its x/y headers are ambiguous, so resolve the confirmation with longitude x and latitude y, then load the resource with map_add_layer. Search nearby hospitals with catalog_register online over bbox [116, 39, 117, 40] and load the result as a second layer. Restyle the imported hospitals layer with layer_set_style using the preset marker-square-red-large. Then hide the online-search layer and move both layers into the display group "workbench" with one layer_set_state call, as if the panel request had arrived. Export every loaded layer with data_export map true in geojson format, and persist the session with map_save. End with exactly one line reporting the imported feature count, the exported artifact count, and the final map revision. Do not echo any resource, artifact, or layer ids in that final line.
